title: encrypt.rs: expect() inside encrypt_aes_cbc closure is unreviewed panic
description: In encrypt(), the closures passed to encrypt_aes_cbc use .expect() calls: 'expect("key is exactly 32 bytes = AES-256 key size")' and 'expect("iv is exactly 16 bytes = AES block size")'. These panics can never trigger because encrypt_aes_cbc always generates key_len and 16-byte IV internally. However, a reader scanning for panic sites will find these and have to verify the invariant. The panic site is inside a closure 20+ lines away from where encrypt_aes_cbc generates the key/IV. The code is correct, but the design makes the safety argument non-local. Either inline the key/IV generation into the callers (removing the closure) or use array slicing to make the lengths compile-time-knowable.
